summary.en: Japanese New Year card and address-book software. Linaro's catalog lists it as working under Prism emulation.
summary.zh-TW: 日本的賀年卡與通訊錄軟體。Linaro 目錄列為可透過 Prism 模擬執行。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Runs as an x64 build under Prism. The result rests on the Linaro catalog alone; the vendor page was not read.
caveats.zh-TW: 以 x64 版本透過 Prism 執行。結果僅依據 Linaro 目錄，未讀取原廠頁面。

caveats.en: Linaro's catalog also lists an NVIDIA validation for this program.
caveats.zh-TW: Linaro 目錄同時列有此程式的 NVIDIA 驗證。

evidence.title: Linaro Works on WoA catalog: fudemame-28 (emulation)
